summary: Block 15: analysis only, R4 untouched. FIVE-CYCLE-INTERFACE.md isolates the smallest interface still blocking replacement of the Lemma 6.7 branch by the accepted finite asset. The branch's Lean form is five_support_step_ban (FiveSupport.lean:89), whose hypotheses are hw, hx : FiveCenter, two support-memberships at a base angle and state-adjacency, and whose conclusion forbids a state transition across sixty (60 degrees). The finite core already exists beside it (five_no_common_adj, five_forced_label, both by decide), and five_no_common_adj takes EXACTLY the validity hypothesis that the finite asset cannot supply. Hence the interface is positional validity at all six 60-degree positions, which today is available only via five_endpoint_no_common (CyclicCore.lean:25) and only with an extra centre-existence hypothesis FiveCenter c (x + direction a + direction b). Precise obstruction: nothing in the tree builds new five-cycle centres by adding two unit directions, and five_support_step_ban forbids a transition rather than transporting validity. Sharpest defensible form: (O'') the stateSupport_shift_relation instance at d = sixty with R = fiveAdj, strictly weaker than the step ban. No claim that the finite classification removes the analytic bridge; no line saving claimed; (O) (O') (O'') all open.
